A LOT of Artemis II data just dropped! 🌖 

814GB of observations. 996 new images. 521min of never-before-released crew audio. 

Questions? The science team behind the data release will be here to answer them tomorrow, Oct. 8, at 1 p.m. EDT. 

This is the first planetary data set captured primarily by humans in more than half a century. As of today, it's ready for the global science community, and all of us, to dig into. Get started here:
